author: FrostedCupcakez
body: I'm sorry if it seems like I am trying to damage Avicus, as I mentioned many times before I am just stating my opinion and giving feedback. Not trying to damage myself, the people concerned/involved, and the server. I'm trying to play nice and a lot of you are sort of stressing me out. I know this is what the staff go through I'm very sorry for giving the staff members stress right now. I just need to clear out my emotions concerning the server. I would like to say thank you for not spazzing at us (most of you) I know many of you are trying to defend the server you love. I love this server as well, I just need to express myself sometimes and so do my friends. This may damage my chances of getting moderator in the future. I realize that, as much as I don't want that I realize that its happening. My chances right now of moderator in the future are getting slimmer by the minute/second. But I'm really sorry guys. But I would like a chance in the future to apply for mod. I would like to help out the server in my way, and if I do apply for mod I would like a chance. I promise if this is the case and I do apply, I will follow the rules.
